status_legend.unmounted: Consumer component exists but no route mounts it.

2026-05-03: Daily SLA recalibrated 25h→49h to absorb FRED T+1 publish lag plus weekend rollover. Joe directive 2026-05-03: 'I only want to know when something breaks. No reds on weekends/holidays for legit-cadence elements.'

2026-05-03 (b): Monthly SLA 816h→1200h, Quarterly SLA 2496h→3600h, term_premium reclassified daily→weekly. Reason: FRED publishes monthlies ~3-4 weeks after period end and quarterlies up to 10 weeks after; previous SLAs flipped chips red while FRED was operating on its normal schedule.

phase4_v11_inventory_pr2a_2026_05_01.reason: v11 Cycle Mechanism page (public/MacroTilt_Macro_Overview_Page_v11.html) renders 22 indicators across 6 mechanism modals; ~half were unregistered AND showing hardcoded mock values. PR #2A formally inventories them with current_status=placeholder_hardcoded so they appear in the manifest as known gaps. PR #2B will wire the ones with free public sources.

phase4_pr2b_wire_2026_05_01.reason: PR #2B wires 10 of the 11 v11 mechanism placeholders to live free public sources (FRED + CBOE + FINRA + Yahoo + computed proxies). cdx_basis points to hy_ig_ratio as practical proxy; xccy_basis remains TBD pending FRED-derivable approximation in PR #2C.

phase4_pr2c_audit_catchup_2026_05_02.reason: PR #2A audit missed 2 v11 mechanism indicators (sofr_ois, naaim) and did not record v11 mechanism participation in consumer_surfaces for ~13 existing indicators. PR #2C closes both gaps.

_meta.last_change: 2026-05-27 — renamed 11 manifest `name` fields to match producer-side pipeline_health indicator_ids (massive-eod, massive-universe, massive-ticker-details, massive-corporate-actions, latest_scan, scenarios, v10_allocation, uw-universe-snapshots). Closes the site-wide red-chip regression where chips found no pipeline_health row for the renamed elements. Paired with the watchdog edge function patch that writes data_as_of on every run.
_meta.v_2026_06_11: 2026-06-11 one-shot stamp fix: registered 11 previously-untracked elements (cycle board, ISM keys, scanner V5 legacy feed, user positions, scenario impact, put/call, dollar index, Buffett, bank unrealized losses, sector perf, scenario stress, indicator-history aggregate).
_meta.v_2026_06_11b: Un-registered put_call/buffett/bank_unreal — these feeds were killed as phantoms on 2026-06-10 (commit 'Kill phantom feeds'); the 2026-06-11 stamp-fix registration pass resurrected them by mistake. Their tracking rows are deleted by the repair workflow. Registration must check kill history first.
_meta.v_2026_06_11c: v12 (2026-06-11 PM): normalized 37 daily market-series SLAs 73h->49h to the documented daily standard (the 73h padding predated honest close-anchored stamps + the 16:30 ET EOD chain and is no longer needed); corrected stale fetch times (scanner 15:30->03:30 overnight run; allocation ->08:15 per its workflow cron).
_meta.v_2026_06_11d: v13 (2026-06-11 PM, Joe SLA doctrine): stale = >24h past due. Same-evening dailies 49h; T+1-publishing FRED dailies 73h (documented basis per element); COT 504h->192h. Monthly/quarterly extended budgets allowed only for documented publication lags — per-series calibration queued.
_meta.freshness_sla_basis: One-clock (FRESHNESS_CHIP_SPEC 2026-06-16): freshness_sla_hours is the JOB's run cadence + grace, NOT the data's publication lag. The chip grades green/red off the LAST PULL (pipeline_health.last_good_at, the job's real last successful run) vs this SLA, calendar-aware so weekends/holidays never count. Daily job = 49h (~2 business days). Weekly job = 192h. Bi-monthly (FINRA) = 480h. Monthly job = 768h. Quarterly job = 2400h. A lagged data series (e.g. a monthly read by the daily job) stays GREEN while the daily job pulls — its weeks-old as_of no longer reds the chip.
_meta.v_2026_06_22: Freshness false-red fix (Joe 2026-06-22): scan-fed feeds zerohedge_public/zerohedge_premium/index_membership were graded on wall-clock so the Juneteenth (Jun 19) holiday + weekend counted against them; switched to nyse-trading-day to match their sibling scan feeds (wide_universe/options_chain). user_scan_data SLA 25h->49h (daily standard; 25h was too tight to survive a holiday+weekend). No data change - the daily scan correctly did not run Fri/Sat/Sun; Jun 18 is the last completed session.
_meta.v_2026_06_22b: Retired sector_perf (Asset Tilt · Sector Performance): orphaned feed — no frontend consumer reads sector_perf.json (the performance/volatility columns it fed were removed in the sector-table redesign). Producer workflow, script, served file, reconciler + watchdog entries all removed. (Joe 2026-06-22)

elements.owner: Senior Quant (methods), Lead Dev (endpoint), Data Steward (governance)
elements.notes: On-demand element (no pipeline_health row - no scheduled producer); page states 'Prices through {date}, fetched live'. Registered 2026-07-27 with the Portfolio Lab page.

elements.name: lse_intraday
elements.description: Live intraday price — latest 1-minute bar from London Strategic Edge (~10 s behind the tape). Display only: every engine stays on official end-of-day closes.
elements.cadence_label: Live · refreshes while you watch (about every 45 s)
elements.refresh_trigger: Edge function lse-live (quotes) — on view, shared 45 s server cache
elements.failure_mode: Live price shows em-dash / last cached bar; engines unaffected.
elements.sla_basis: Market-hours clock, 3h (paper-intraday precedent); pauses at the close.
elements.cadence_display: On view · live during market hours

elements.name: lse_atm_iv
elements.description: At-the-money implied-volatility term structure per underlying (calls, per expiry), from London Strategic Edge's own pricing models. Feeds the Portfolio Lab's Implied vol method.
elements.cadence_label: On view (cached 30 min) · daily heartbeat 17:50 ET
elements.refresh_trigger: Edge function lse-live (iv) on Portfolio Lab view; daily heartbeat via the scanner IV batch

consumer_surfaces.tile: Implied vol expected-return method (range + optimizer volatility)

elements.failure_mode: Implied vol rows show em-dash; method falls back to CAPM + historical volatility.
elements.sla_basis: 49h daily budget; the scan batch is the guaranteed daily pull.

elements.name: lse_iv_scan
elements.description: ~30-day at-the-money implied vol per scanner name plus a cross-sectional volatility rank (percentile of implied vol across the day's covered scan names).
elements.refresh_trigger: pg_cron lse-scan-iv-daily (21:50 UTC weekdays) -> edge function lse-live (scan_iv)

consumer_surfaces.tile: Insider Conviction table — Vol rank column

elements.failure_mode: Vol rank column all em-dash + red chip. Structural coverage gaps (LSE options universe covers actively-traded names only) show em-dash per name by design.
elements.sla_basis: Joe 2026-06-11 doctrine: daily + 24h grace = 49h; data window 78h covers the scan-date lag over weekends.

elements.name: lse_archive_iv
elements.description: Previous-close ATM implied-vol term structure for names the LIVE options feed does not cover (derived nightly from London Strategic Edge’s options-prints research archive; strikes within ±10% of the close, days-to-expiry computed from the expiry date, discounted Black-76). Rows are dated and the Portfolio Lab labels them “as of <date> close”. Names with live coverage are untouched — live wins.

consumer_surfaces.tile: Implied vol expected-return method (range + optimizer volatility)

elements.failure_mode: Archive rows absent/stale → the name reverts to the honest CAPM fallback note.
elements.sla_basis: 49h daily budget, calendar-aware (weekend hours don’t count).
